objective: Browser-first Figma replacement with a Rust document engine
completionPolicy: Individual feature deployments are progress, not completion of the replacement.
implemented: frame clipping across canvas, selection and SVG
automatic containment and atomic drag reparenting
embedded raster images, fill/fit cropping, replacement, file/drop/paste import
frame resize constraints on both axes with nested propagation and live preview
uniform corner radius, composited layer/frame opacity, independent solid fill and centered stroke
horizontal/vertical auto layout, padding, gap, alignment, hug/fill sizing, ignored children and drag reordering
vector anchor insertion/deletion, curve-preserving subdivision, corner/smooth conversion and anchor nudging
remaining: Additional frame layout controls and layout grids
Nested groups and complete tree reordering
SVG import and vector clipboard interoperability
Rotation, independent corner radii, multiple paints, stroke alignment/dashes, gradients and effects
Vector path joining/splitting, Boolean operations, pencil smoothing and slice export
Auto layout wrapping/grid, min/max sizing, text auto-sizing, group layout units and on-canvas spacing controls
Components, instances, variants, reusable styles and variables
Cloud document storage, authentication, sharing, permissions and collaboration
Broader export formats, accessibility and performance validation
Comprehensive workflow parity review against the agreed Figma replacement scope
deferred: Desktop application: browser version is the current priority
